messages:
zoe_sales: Starting POC prep for Kepler (payments). They provided two variants: kepler-lite-int8 and kepler-max-qat. Needs Dedicated with Hosted fallback, 50 qps steady, p95 <200ms (lite) and <700ms (max). Also asked about KMS BYO, SOC2, and committed pricing. cc @mark_eng @ivana_ml @harry_ops

mark_eng: Ask for max seq length, tokenizer, and any custom ops. Prefer a plain torch.load path and a tiny synthetic checkpoint to validate load.

zoe_sales: Seq = 3072, tokenizer = HF byte-level BPE with 3k vocab. They mentioned fused attention in QAT but no custom CUDA ops declared.

ivana_ml: 3k seq + KV cache affects memory. QAT fused attention may not match our optimized kernels. Request both fused and unfused loader and a labeled eval set for determinism checks.

harry_ops: Infra note: 50 qps batched likely needs 2x optimized reserved nodes for lite, 3x for max if multi-card. We support BYO KMS on Dedicated/Private; Hosted requires enterprise onboarding. I'll run a quick cost sim once we know batch sizes.

zoe_sales: Can we give a rough ballpark to procurement before cost sim?

harry_ops: Ballpark: lite ~ "$14k/mo"; max ~ "$42k/mo". Will refine after perf runs.

ivana_ml: Plan: 1) compatibility scan (loader + forward) 2) perf profile (batching/KV) 3) quant sweep if needed 4) canary Dedicated + enable Hosted fallback. Owners: @mark_eng scan/profile, @ivana_ml quant, @harry_ops infra, @nina_sec SQ.

mark_eng: I'll need s3 link with tokenizer, loader, and a small checkpoint (100MB) plus expected input shapes.

zoe_sales: I'll request artifacts today. Also they want logs to SIEM.

nina_sec: Draft SQ points: we do not persist customer inputs beyond configured retention; KV cache ephemeral by default; audit logs exportable to customer SIEM; KMS onboarding 2-3 weeks. I'll attach SOC2 references.

opsbot: Note: maintenance Fri 01:00-02:00 UTC may affect fallback tests.

zoe_sales: Timeline proposed to Kepler: artifacts today, compatibility scan Tue, perf/quant Wed-Thu, canary Fri if scans pass. I'll post S3 links and SQ answers here. :thumbsup:
